name: AK16AH - Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, TVOC, HCHO, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, Temperature, Humidity), NDIR Infrared & Electrochemical Sensors
highlights: The AK16A With Two Sensors Upgraded — Same 24 mm panel, same eight readings, same 30-per-carton spec. CO₂ moves from semiconductor to infrared NDIR and formaldehyde to an electrochemical cell — the two readings customers question most.

What Changes in Practice — Semiconductor elements respond to humidity, alcohol, perfume and cleaning products. Infrared and electrochemical measurement do not. The reading stops moving for reasons that have nothing to do with air quality.
Laser Particulates Unchanged — PM1.0, PM2.5 and PM10 continue on the same laser module — already the accurate method, so there was nothing to upgrade.
The Specification Tier of the AK16 Platform — Where a figure goes into a report, supports a purchase decision, or gets compared against a regulatory threshold, this is the AK16 to quote.
2000 mAh, Six Hours, 249 g — 30 pcs per carton, same colour box as the rest of the platform.
